name: CertScore.ai
description:
Use CertScore when you want Claude to scan or audit a website for cookies, trackers, consent behavior, GDPR/ePrivacy risk signals, privacy-policy gaps, TLS, CMP or related CCPA/CPRA signals. Claude can start a scan, retrieve the result, inspect pre-consent cookies and trackers, and explain findings in plain language. Results are automated public-web observations for review, not legal conclusions or compliance determinations.

Ask Claude to: scan a domain for GDPR/CCPA compliance signals, pull the latest completed scan for a site, explain a specific finding in plain language, or export findings into a report for legal or a client. The compact scan bundle returns status, findings, supporting evidence, and the exact pre-consent cookies/trackers detected in one retrieval step.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CertScore.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CertScore.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.certscore.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CertScore.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CertScore.ai provides these MCP tools: explain_finding, export_findings, get_evidence, get_latest_domain_pre_consent_cookies_trackers, get_latest_domain_scan, get_pre_consent_cookies_trackers, get_report, get_scan, get_scan_status, list_findings, scan_site, and get_scan_bundle.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CertScore.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CertScore.ai in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
CertScore.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CertScore.ai is developed by CertScore.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
